nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.stage1_segment¶

CT-PET v5 stage 1 (per-subject): TotalSegmentator on CT input.

Runs every CT_TASKS task sequentially for a single PESA* subject via nvitk.segmentation.total_segmentator.run_totalsegmentator(). All outputs are written under RESULTS/<batch>/res_segmentation_ct/<SUBJECT>/CT/ with the task name as the file stem (<task>.nii.gz).

Stage orchestration (loops over subjects, local vs. SGE dispatch) lives in nvitk.pipes.pesa_fat.ct_pet_v5.run; this module is a pure worker.
